exposure: parity (nulliparous, primiparous, multiparous (2-4 deliveries), grand multiparous)
outcome: Female Sexual Function Index (FSFI) score (total, orgasm, etc.)
cohort: 363 consecutive women who presented to the Department of Gynaecology
finding: The incidence of sexual dysfunction increased with increasing parity, with grand multiparous women having a significantly higher incidence compared to nulliparous women.
